comments.body: I'd suggest 40617943b8ee85a92da396ca52e28a8715f84087 from #6946 for the cross-compile error, and some of the changes from #7057 for the validation errors. golangci-lint v2.12.x didn't support Go 1.27, which is what's available during that job.

For the conformance test errors, something like 36575ba3b1f0d446a0ba4a6fdab61a0a472a67f5 from #7077 should catch our behavior up to that of the updated version of dockerd.
The integration tests appear to be expecting some packages that we dropped from the VMs in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/automation/pull/25.  I guess the `run_integration()` and `run_in_podman()` shell functions in `hack/ci/runner.sh` could try installing them?
